decisions.reason: GA4 is the current Google Analytics standard, so continued investment and public mention align with the firm's announced analytics direction, making persistence likely.
Universal Analytics has been permanently discontinued by Google, so disappointing results cannot be attributed to temporary causes, and the firm will drop the obsolete plugin despite sunk costs.
The retail system interface plugin supports the firm's consulting work and represents a moderate investment, so management will likely persist to justify the commitment.
The dedicated page signals strong public commitment and the service is central to the firm's SEO consulting offerings, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
